items.en: Saturday's kind of up in the air for me. Can we just play it by ear?
items.ja: 土曜はまだちょっとどうなるかわからなくて。その時の流れで決めてもいい？ →「もちろん。当日の朝にメッセージして。」
items.speaker: kk-slider
choices: Totally. Just text me that morning.
Sure, I can hear you fine.
items.note: play it by ear＝その場で決める。耳や楽器の話ではない
items.tts: Saturday's kinda up in the air for me. Can we just play it by ear?

items.en: What do you say we just order in and call it a night?
items.ja: もう出前にして、今日はおしまいってことでどう？ →「しょうがないなあ（大賛成）。メニュー取ってくる。」
items.speaker: bob
choices: You twisted my arm. I'll grab the menus.
items.note: Whaddaya say…?＝〜しない？ 意見を聞いてはいない
items.tts: Whaddaya say we just order in an' call it a night?

items.en: Did you seriously just throw me under the bus in front of the whole team?
items.ja: ねえ、チーム全員の前で私に責任をなすりつけたよね？ →「うん、わかってる。あれはひどかった。ごめん。」
items.speaker: audie
choices: I know, I know. That was out of line. Sorry.
No, I took the train this morning.
Yeah, the whole team was there.
items.note: throw under the bus＝人に責任を押しつける
items.tts: Didja seriously just throw me under the bus in fronna the whole team?

items.en: I know you don't have the list on you, but off the top of your head, how many are we expecting?
items.ja: リストが手元にないのはわかってるけど、パッと思いつく範囲で、何人くらい来そう？ →「ざっくり？30人、多くて35人かな。」
items.speaker: cj
choices: My head's fine, thanks for asking.
No, it's on top of the fridge.
items.note: off the top of your head＝パッと思いつく範囲で
items.tts: I know you don't have the list on ya, but off the top of your head, how many're we expectin'?

items.en: Ugh, I've been so busy, what with the book deal and the podcast and everything.
items.ja: はあ、忙しくてさ。本の出版契約とか、ポッドキャストとか、いろいろで。 →「まあ、お気の毒に。君でいるのも大変だね。」
items.speaker: marshal
choices: Oh, you poor thing. Must be exhausting being you.
Which book are you reading at the moment?
No, I'm not busy this week.
items.note: 自慢話にはからかいで返す。what with＝〜やら

items.en: Dude, you've got something on your face. Nah, I'm just pulling your leg.
items.ja: おい、顔に何かついてるぞ。…なんてな、冗談だよ。 →「おもしろいね。一瞬だまされた。」
items.speaker: teddy
choices: Very funny. You got me for a second.
Ow! Let go of my leg!
items.note: pull your leg＝からかう。最後の Nah で冗談と判明
items.tts: Dude, you've got somethin' on your face. Nah, I'm just pullin' your leg.

items.en: Oh, great, another 'quick sync' at 6 p.m. on a Friday. My favorite.
items.ja: 最高、金曜の18時にまた「ちょっとした打ち合わせ」。大好き。 →「ほんとそれ。メールで済まないか聞いてみようか？」
items.speaker: molly
choices: Ugh, I know. Want me to ask if it can be an email?
Great! I love quick meetings too.
It's at six on Friday, right?
items.note: great と favorite は皮肉。同調するのが自然
items.tts: Oh, great, another quick sync at six p.m. on a Friday. My favorite.

items.en: Let me guess. You forgot your wallet again?
items.ja: 当ててあげようか。また財布を忘れたんでしょ？ →「わかった、わかった。金曜に返すって。約束。」
items.speaker: flick
choices: Okay, okay. I'll pay you back Friday. Promise.
Sure, guess as many times as you like.
No, it was my wallet, not yours.
items.note: Let me guess＝どうせ〜でしょ。からかいの定番
items.tts: Lemme guess. You forgot your wallet again?

items.en: I'm going to hit the sack. You good to lock up?
items.ja: もう寝るわ。戸締まり頼んでいい？ →「うん、やっとく。おやすみ！」
items.speaker: kicks
choices: Sure, the sack's by the door.
items.note: hit the sack＝寝る。lock up と look up に注意
items.tts: I'm gonna hit the sack. You good to lock up?

items.en: Don't quote me on this, but I'm pretty sure they're going to push it back to spring.
items.ja: 確かな話じゃないけど、春に延期になると思うよ。 →「了解。じゃあ、予約はまだ待っておく。」
items.speaker: lopez
choices: Gotcha. I'll hold off on booking anything, then.
Sure, I'll put it in quotes.
items.note: Don't quote me＝確証はない。断定と取らない
items.tts: Don't quote me on this, but I'm pretty sure they're gonna push it back to spring.

items.en: You're kind of breaking up on my end. Want to try turning your video off?
items.ja: そっちの音声、ちょっと途切れてるみたい。ビデオをオフにしてみる？ →「うん、ちょっと待って。これでどう？」
items.speaker: goldie
choices: Sure, give me a sec. Is that any better?
Wait, you're breaking up with me?
Yeah, I'll turn it off at the end.
items.note: breaking up＝音声が途切れる。別れ話ではない
items.tts: You're kinda breakin' up on my end. Wanna try turnin' your video off?

items.en: Honestly? I couldn't care less what they think of my hair.
items.ja: 正直？私の髪をどう思われようが、どうでもいい。 →「その意気だよ。どっちにしても似合ってる。」
items.speaker: label
choices: Good for you. It looks great anyway.
Oh, so you care a lot?
Less hair? Are you getting it cut?
items.note: couldn't care less＝全く気にしない

items.en: That one's on the house. You look like you've had a day.
items.ja: それはサービスです。大変な一日だったみたいですね。 →「いやもう、ほんとに。ありがとう、優しいですね。」
items.speaker: wolfgang
choices: Ha, you have no idea. Thanks, that's really sweet.
Which house? I live in an apartment.
items.note: on the house＝店のおごり。had a day＝散々な日

items.en: I had to bite my tongue when he said the whole thing was his idea.
items.ja: 全部自分のアイデアだって彼が言ったとき、ぐっとこらえたよ。 →「えらい。よく何も言わなかったね。」
items.speaker: daisy-mae
choices: Wow. I'm impressed you didn't say anything.
So you told him it was your idea?
items.note: bite my tongue＝言いたいのを我慢する

items.en: Boarding closes in ten. You're cutting it pretty close.
items.ja: 搭乗締め切りまで10分です。かなりギリギリですよ。 →「ですよね。保安検査を早く通る方法はありますか？」
items.speaker: orville
choices: I know. Is there a faster way through security?
It's pretty close, about ten minutes' walk.
items.note: cut it close＝時間ギリギリ。距離の close ではない
items.tts: Boardin' closes in ten. You're cuttin' it pretty close.

items.en: Look, I'd grab the full coverage. Most folks who skip it end up kicking themselves.
items.ja: フル補償にしときなよ。付けなかった人はたいてい後悔するんだから。 →「ありがとう。でもクレジットカードで補償されてるので。」
items.speaker: tom-nook
choices: Thanks, but my credit card already covers it.
No, I'd rather skip the line.
items.note: kick oneself＝後悔する。押し売りは丁寧に断る
items.tts: Look, I'd grab the full coverage. Most folks who skip it end up kickin' themselves.

items.en: The presentation went... well, let's just say the projector had a better day than I did.
items.ja: プレゼンは…まあ、プロジェクターのほうが私よりましな一日だったってとこかな。 →「あらら。一杯飲みながら話、聞こうか？」
items.speaker: ankha
choices: Oh no. Want to grab a drink and tell me about it?
Congratulations. I knew you'd nail it.
items.note: let's just say＝はっきり言わないが悪い結果

items.en: I'm doing a coffee run. Want anything, or are you good?
items.ja: コーヒー買いに行くけど、何かいる？それとも大丈夫？ →「大丈夫、ありがとう。あ、待って、アイスラテを頼めたら最高。」
items.speaker: tia
choices: I'm good, thanks. Actually, wait, an iced latte would be amazing.
Yeah, I'm pretty good at it.
No, I don't run in the mornings.
items.note: are you good?＝いらない？ の確認。coffee run＝買い出し
items.tts: I'm doin' a coffee run. Want anything, or are ya good?

items.en: So he just ghosted me. Like, totally fell off the face of the earth.
items.ja: で、彼に急に連絡を絶たれたの。もう、完全に音信不通。 →「最低。あなたにはもっといい人がいるよ。」
items.speaker: lily
choices: Ugh, what a coward. You deserve way better.
A ghost? Where did you see it?
Did he hurt himself when he fell?
items.note: ghost＝急に連絡を絶つ。幽霊ではない

items.en: It's a really generous offer. Would it be okay if I slept on it?
items.ja: 本当にありがたいお話です。一晩考えさせていただいてもいいですか？ →「もちろん。金曜までにお返事ください。」
items.speaker: reneigh
choices: Of course. Just let us know by Friday.
There's a sofa in the break room.
No, we didn't sleep much either.
items.note: sleep on it＝一晩考える。即答を避ける定番

items.en: So now they want it by Wednesday? Talk about moving the goalposts.
items.ja: 今度は水曜まで？ころころ条件を変えるよな。 →「ほんとそれ。押し返してみようか？」
items.speaker: kabuki
choices: Tell me about it. Want me to push back?
Which goalposts? The ones on the field?
items.note: move the goalposts＝途中で条件を変える

items.en: Look, we really dropped the ball on this one, and that's on me.
items.ja: 今回は本当にこちらの落ち度です。私の責任です。 →「そう言っていただけると。どう挽回しましょうか？」
items.speaker: judy
choices: I appreciate that. So how do we fix it?
Don't worry, I'll pick the ball up.
On you? I can't see anything.
items.note: drop the ball＝しくじる。that's on me＝私の責任

items.en: Pineapple on pizza? Hey, whatever floats your boat.
items.ja: ピザにパイナップル？まあ、好きにすれば。 → つまり、自分は好きじゃないが、ご自由に。
items.speaker: anchovy
choices: He doesn't like it, but it's up to you.
He thinks pineapple pizza is great.
items.note: floats your boat＝好み。船の話ではない

items.en: Whoa, hold your horses. We haven't even seen the apartment yet.
items.ja: ちょっと待って、落ち着いて。まだ部屋も見てないよ。 → つまり、決めるのが早すぎる。
items.speaker: rosie
choices: She wants to wait for the horses.
items.note: hold your horses＝早まらないで

items.en: Opera? I mean, I'm sure it's lovely. It's just... three hours is a lot of hours.
items.ja: オペラ？いや、きっと素敵なんだろうけど。ただ…3時間って、けっこうな時間だよね。 → つまり、長すぎて気が進まない。
items.speaker: fauna
choices: Three hours sounds too long to her.
She thinks it's lovely, so she's in.
She's asking how long it lasts.
items.note: I'm sure it's lovely の後の just… が本音

items.en: Yeah, no, I'm not doing karaoke again. Not after last time.
items.ja: うん、いや、カラオケはもうやらない。前回のあとじゃね。 → つまり、絶対に行かない。
items.speaker: bea
items.note: Yeah, no＝「いや」。最後の no が本音
items.tts: Yeah, no, I'm not doin' karaoke again. Not after last time.

items.en: Free protein shakes after class? Dude, that's a no-brainer. Sign me up.
items.ja: クラスの後にプロテイン無料？そんなの迷うまでもない。申し込むよ。 → つまり、もちろん参加する。
items.speaker: dom
choices: He thinks it's a stupid idea.
He's too tired to think about it.
items.note: no-brainer＝考えるまでもない。バカの意ではない

items.en: Come on, it's a printer, not rocket science. Just pull out the jammed paper.
items.ja: ちょっと、ただのプリンターだよ、ロケット工学じゃあるまいし。詰まった紙を引き抜けばいい。 → つまり、簡単に直せる。
items.speaker: kid-cat
choices: The printer is broken for good.
items.note: not rocket science＝難しくない
items.tts: C'mon, it's a printer, not rocket science. Just pull out the jammed paper.

items.en: Oh, thanks a lot for finishing the milk. Really appreciate it.
items.ja: あー、牛乳飲み干してくれて、どうもありがとう。助かるわ。 → つまり、牛乳を全部飲まれて怒っている。
items.speaker: lucky
choices: He's annoyed you drank all the milk.
He's grateful you bought more milk.
He wants you to finish the milk.
items.note: thanks a lot は皮肉。平板な口調が本音

items.en: He's a sweet guy. Not exactly the sharpest tool in the shed, though.
items.ja: いい人だよ。まあ、頭はあんまり切れないけどね。 → つまり、いい人だが賢くはない。
items.speaker: tammy
choices: He's nice, but not very smart.
He's smart, but not very nice.
items.note: sharpest tool＝頭の切れ。though＝でもね

items.en: You're going to run a marathon? I'll believe it when I see it.
items.ja: マラソン走るの？実際に見るまで信じないよ。 → つまり、本当にやるとは思っていない。
items.speaker: daisy-mae
choices: She doubts you'll actually do it.
She wants to come and watch.
items.note: 見たら信じる＝今は疑っている
items.tts: You're gonna run a marathon? I'll believe it when I see it.

items.en: Missed the last train? Well, the night bus is... an experience.
items.ja: 終電逃した？まあ、夜行バスは…なかなかの体験だよ。 → つまり、夜行バスは快適じゃない。
items.speaker: raymond
choices: The night bus is fun and exciting.
items.note: an experience は婉曲。いい意味ではない

items.en: Forty bucks for a candle? That's a little steep, isn't it?
items.ja: キャンドルに40ドル？ちょっと高すぎない？ → つまり、高すぎて買う気はない。
items.speaker: poppy
choices: She thinks the candle costs too much.
She thinks the shelf is too high.
items.note: steep＝高い。bucks＝ドル。坂の話ではない

items.en: Look, I'm not saying it's your fault. I'm just saying it happened on your watch.
items.ja: 君のせいだと言ってるんじゃない。ただ、君の担当中に起きたと言ってるだけだ。 → つまり、遠回しに責めている。
items.speaker: henry
items.note: on your watch＝あなたの担当中。腕時計ではない

items.en: Camping in November? I'm going to pass, but you guys have fun.
items.ja: 11月にキャンプ？パスするよ、みんなは楽しんで。 → つまり、行かない。
items.speaker: kicks
items.note: pass＝遠慮する。通り過ぎる意ではない
items.tts: Campin' in November? I'm gonna pass, but you guys have fun.

items.en: A house? In this economy? Sure, I'll just pick one up on the way home.
items.ja: 家？このご時世に？はいはい、帰りにひとつ買ってくるよ。 → つまり、家なんて買えない。
items.speaker: hamlet
choices: He's buying a house on the way home.
items.note: pick up＝ついでに買う。皮肉で不可能を表す

items.en: Wow. Tough crowd tonight.
items.ja: うわ。今夜のお客さんは手ごわいね。 → つまり、ジョークが全然ウケなかった。
items.speaker: pietro
items.note: tough crowd＝笑わない客。人数の話ではない

items.en: So, quick heads-up: you hit reply-all on that email about the boss.
items.ja: ちょっと知らせとくけど、上司についてのあのメール、全員に返信してたよ。 → つまり、上司を含む全員に届いた。
items.speaker: gulliver
choices: Your email went to everyone, boss included.
The boss wants you to reply.
items.note: heads-up＝事前の知らせ。reply-all＝全員に返信

items.en: That's... certainly a bold choice of shirt for a job interview.
items.ja: それは…面接にしては、なかなか大胆なシャツね。 → つまり、着替えたほうがいい。
items.speaker: celeste
choices: She thinks you should change your shirt.
She loves how confident it looks.
She's asking where you bought it.
items.note: bold choice は婉曲な否定。certainly で強調

items.en: Another slice? Well, I wouldn't say no.
items.ja: もう一切れ？まあ、断りはしないね。 → つまり、ぜひ欲しい。
items.speaker: blathers
choices: He's too full to eat more.
items.note: wouldn't say no＝控えめな「ぜひ」

items.en: I'd take anything Greg says with a grain of salt.
items.ja: グレッグの言うことは、話半分に聞いたほうがいいよ。 → つまり、グレッグの話はあまり信用できない。
items.speaker: judy
choices: Don't fully believe what Greg says.
items.note: with a grain of salt＝割り引いて聞く

items.en: Him? Apologize? Yeah, when pigs fly.
items.ja: あいつが？謝る？ああ、ブタが空を飛んだらね。 → つまり、絶対に謝らない。
items.speaker: sterling
items.note: when pigs fly＝ありえない。Yeah は皮肉

items.en: I'm kind of on the fence about the job. Like, the money's great, but the commute? Brutal.
items.ja: その仕事、ちょっと迷ってるんだよね。お金はいいけど、通勤が？地獄。 → つまり、受けるか決めかねている。
items.speaker: lily
choices: She can't decide whether to take it.
items.note: on the fence＝どっちつかず。断ったわけではない
items.tts: I'm kinda on the fence about the job. Like, the money's great, but the commute? Brutal.

items.en: Hey, it's Dan. Listen, no pressure at all, but if you happened to be free Saturday, and you happened to own a van...
items.ja: もしもし、ダンだけど。全然無理しなくていいんだけど、もし土曜が空いてて、もしバンを持ってたりしたら…。 → つまり、土曜にバンで手伝ってほしい。
items.speaker: cj
choices: He wants you and your van on Saturday.
He's inviting you out on Saturday.
items.note: 仮定を重ねた遠回しな頼み。no pressure は前置き
items.tts: Hey, it's Dan. Listen, no pressure at all, but if you happened ta be free Saturday, an' you happened ta own a van...

items.en: Folks, we're going to be in a bit of a holding pattern for, uh, twenty-odd minutes. Nothing to worry about.
items.ja: 皆さま、えー、20分ほど上空で旋回待機となります。ご心配には及びません。 → つまり、到着が20分あまり遅れる。
items.speaker: shep
choices: The plane will land twenty-plus minutes late.
items.note: holding pattern＝着陸待ちの旋回。-odd＝〜あまり
items.tts: Folks, we're gonna be in a bit of a holdin' pattern for, uh, twenty-odd minutes. Nothing to worry about.

items.en: An accountant? So, business, then. Definitely not pleasure.
items.ja: 会計士？ということは仕事ですね。楽しみのほうではなさそうだ。 → つまり、会計士は退屈だとからかっている。
items.speaker: octavian
choices: He's joking that accounting is dull.
He thinks you're lying about your job.
He wants to see your business card.
items.note: Business or pleasure? を使った冗談。疑われてはいない

items.en: What do you think of the new guy, honestly?
items.ja: 新しく来た人、正直どう思う？
items.speaker: goldie
items.note: whaddaya＝what do you。過去の did なら whadja
items.tts: Whaddaya think of the new guy, honestly?

items.en: Give me a sec, I'm almost done with this level.
items.ja: ちょっと待って、このステージもうすぐ終わるから。
items.speaker: dom
items.note: gimme＝give me。give 'im／give 'em と紛らわしい
items.tts: Gimme a sec, I'm almost done with this level.

items.en: If we're catching the last train, we have to leave by 11:30.
items.ja: 終電に乗るなら、11時半には出ないと。
items.speaker: rosie
items.note: hafta＝have to。過去の had to は「ハットゥ」
items.tts: If we're catchin' the last train, we hafta leave by eleven-thirty.

items.en: I would've told you if I'd known.
items.ja: 知ってたら、言ってたよ。
items.speaker: maple
items.note: I'da は would've。否定なら n't が残る
items.tts: I'da told ya if I'da known.

items.en: I sort of forgot to call her back.
items.ja: 折り返し電話するの、なんとなく忘れちゃって。
items.speaker: agnes
items.note: sorta＝sort of。t が弾音で「ソーダ」に近い
items.tts: I sorta forgot ta call 'er back.

items.en: You going to eat that, or can I have it?
items.ja: それ食べる？それとももらっていい？
items.speaker: bob
items.note: Are の省略。gonna／wanna／gotta は母音で区別
items.tts: You gonna eat that, or can I have it?

items.en: If he calls, just tell him I'm in a meeting.
items.ja: もし彼から電話が来たら、会議中だって言っておいて。
items.speaker: zucker
items.note: tell 'im は h が落ち「テリム」。'em なら「テレム」
items.tts: If he calls, just tell 'im I'm in a meeting.

items.en: You ought to get that looked at. It's been weeks.
items.ja: それ、診てもらったほうがいいよ。もう何週間もでしょ。
items.speaker: daisy-mae
items.note: oughta は t が弾音で「アーダ」に近い。助言
items.tts: You oughta get that looked at. It's been weeks.

items.en: We used to come here every summer when I was a kid.
items.ja: 子どものころ、毎年夏にここに来てたんだ。
items.speaker: anchovy
items.note: useta＝used to。d は聞こえず「ユースタ」
items.tts: We useta come here every summer when I was a kid.

items.en: What are you up to this weekend?
items.ja: 今週末、何するの？
items.speaker: lily
items.note: whatcha は are が消える。were なら過去の話
items.tts: Whatcha up to this weekend?

items.en: Why don't you just ask her?
items.ja: 彼女に直接聞いてみたら？
items.speaker: judy
items.note: dontcha＝don't you。didn't you は「ディドゥンチャ」
items.tts: Why dontcha just ask 'er?

items.en: It could've been way worse, honestly.
items.ja: 正直、もっとずっとひどくてもおかしくなかったよ。
items.speaker: frett
items.note: couldn't have なら「最悪だった」で意味が逆
items.tts: It coulda been way worse, honestly.

items.en: He's got to get it done by Monday.
items.ja: 彼は月曜までにそれを終わらせないといけない。
items.speaker: julian

lines.en: You do realise you're saying that in front of an Australian?
lines.ja: オーストラリア人の前でそれ言う？

items.en: Want me to park it? No offense, but we'd like to get home tonight. Wow. Okay. I've done this, like, a thousand times. Yeah, and that's attempt number four.
items.ja: それ以上言ったら歩いて帰ってもらうよ。
items.speaker: teddy
choices: Keep talking and you're walking home.
Thanks, a thousand would be great.
items.ask: つぎの ひとことは？
items.note: attempt number four＝今ので4回目というからかい

lines.en: Want me to park it? No offense, but we'd like to get home tonight.
lines.ja: 俺が停めようか？悪いけど、今夜中には帰りたいし。
lines.tts: Want me ta park it? No offense, but we'd like to get home tonight.

lines.en: Wow. Okay. I've done this, like, a thousand times.
lines.ja: へえ。あっそう。これ、千回はやってるんですけど。

lines.en: Yeah, and that's attempt number four.
lines.ja: うん、で、今のが4回目のトライね。

items.en: I can't go any lower on the rate, but I could throw in the installation for free.
items.ja: これ以上料金は下げられませんが、設置費を無料でお付けできます。 →「助かります。それを書面でいただけますか？」
items.speaker: gulliver
choices: That helps. Could you put that in writing?
No thanks, I'll throw it out myself.
items.note: throw in＝おまけで付ける。料金自体は下がっていない

items.en: Honestly, that's a little outside what we'd budgeted. If there's any wiggle room on your end, we'd love to make this work.
items.ja: 正直、予算を少し超えていまして。そちらで多少融通がきくなら、ぜひ進めたいのですが。 → つまり、値下げしてほしい。
items.speaker: judy
choices: She wants a lower price before she agrees.
She's happy to pay the price as it is.
items.note: budget を超える＋wiggle room＝値下げの要求

items.en: Look, I'll be straight with you. That's my final offer, and between you and me, there's another buyer coming at four.
items.ja: いいかい、正直に言うよ。これが最終提示だ。ここだけの話、4時に別の買い手が来るんだ。 → つまり、早く決めろと急かしている。
items.speaker: shep
choices: He's pushing you to decide right now.
He'll drop the price if you wait.
He's already sold it to someone else.
items.note: 別の買い手の話は決断を急がせる常套句
items.tts: Look, I'll be straight with ya. That's my final offer, and between you and me, there's another buyer comin' at four.

items.en: The company down the road quoted us $1,200 for the same job. Can you match that?
items.ja: 近くの会社は同じ工事で1,200ドルの見積もりでした。同じ額にできますか？ →「そこまでは無理ですが、うちは古いものの撤去込みです。」
items.speaker: tangy
choices: Not quite, but our price includes hauling the old stuff away.
Yes, we're just down the road.
items.note: match＝同額にする。距離や数字の繰り返しは罠
items.tts: The company down the road quoted us twelve hundred for the same job. Can you match that?

items.en: We'll put a hold of $450 on your card, which drops to $150 if you take the full coverage.
items.ja: カードに450ドルの仮押さえをします。フル補償に入れば150ドルになります。
items.speaker: hamlet
items.note: drops to の後が補償ありの額。差額300は罠
items.tts: We'll put a hold of four-fifty on your card, which drops to one-fifty if you take the full coverage.
items.ask: フル補償なら いくら押さえる？

items.en: If you can sign by Friday, I might be able to get my manager to sweeten the deal a little.
items.ja: 金曜までにご契約いただければ、上司に掛け合って条件を少し良くできるかもしれません。 → つまり、早く決めれば値引きの可能性がある。
items.speaker: maple
choices: A better offer may be possible if you decide soon.
Her manager has already approved a discount.
The offer ends on Friday whatever happens.
items.note: might be able to は未確定。sweeten＝条件を良くする

items.en: So, can we shake on twelve percent, or do you need to run it by your team first?
items.ja: では12パーセントで手を打ちますか、それともまずチームに確認が必要ですか？ →「確認は要りますが、前向きです。」
items.speaker: octavian
choices: I'd need to check with them, but I'm optimistic.
Yes, I run with my team every week.
We shook on it last year, actually.
items.note: run it by＝確認を取る。shake on＝合意する
items.tts: So, can we shake on twelve percent, or d'you need to run it by your team first?

items.en: This is the third time this week the dishes have sat in the sink overnight, and every time you say you'll get to them.
items.ja: 今週、お皿が一晩シンクに置きっぱなしなのはこれで3回目。毎回「やるから」って言うよね。 →「ほんとにごめん。今すぐ洗う。」
items.speaker: pekoe
choices: You're right, I'm sorry. I'm doing them right now.
Sure, I'll get to them later.
That's right, it's the third time.
items.note: 「あとでやる」はもう通じない。今すぐ動くのが正解

items.en: I appreciate you're only following policy, but I'd like to speak to someone who can actually make a decision.
items.ja: あなたが規則に従っているだけなのはわかりますが、実際に判断できる方と話したいです。 → つまり、上の人を出してほしい。
items.speaker: olivia
choices: She wants to talk to a manager.
items.note: someone who can make a decision＝上司を出して

items.en: Right. So I ordered a king-size, and what's turned up is, generously, a large single.
items.ja: で、キングサイズを頼んだのに、届いたのは、甘く見ても大きめのシングルだ。 → つまり、ずっと小さいものが届いた。
items.speaker: chief
choices: He got a much smaller bed than he ordered.
He got a bigger bed than he ordered.
items.note: generously＝甘く見ても。届いたのは大幅に小さい

items.en: I was quoted $79 a month, but I've been charged $97 for three months now.
items.ja: 月79ドルと言われたのに、もう3か月も97ドル請求されているんです。
items.speaker: molly
items.note: 79と97の逆転に注意。差額18×3か月
items.tts: I was quoted seventy-nine a month, but I've been charged ninety-seven for three months now.
items.ask: 払いすぎた 合計は？

items.en: Excuse me, sorry to be a pain, but this is barely warm in the middle.
items.ja: すみません、面倒をかけて申し訳ないんですが、これ真ん中がほとんど温かくないです。 →「失礼しました。すぐ作り直させます。」
items.speaker: anchovy
choices: Oh, I'm so sorry. I'll have the kitchen redo it.
Sure, the middle table is free.
items.note: sorry to be a pain は前置き。本題は「ぬるい」

items.en: We were supposed to leave at noon. It's two, and you're still packing.
items.ja: お昼に出発するはずだったよね。もう2時なのに、まだ荷造りしてる。
items.speaker: francine
items.note: supposed to は s'posta と縮む。d はほぼ聞こえない
items.tts: We were s'posta leave at noon. It's two, and you're still packing.

items.en: Don't get me wrong, I love a little music. I'd just love it a lot more before midnight.
items.ja: 誤解しないで、音楽は好きなんだ。ただ、夜中の12時前ならもっと好きなんだけどね。 → つまり、深夜の音楽をやめてほしい。
items.speaker: kabuki
choices: Please stop playing music so late.
He'd like to join in with the music.
Please play it louder before midnight.
items.note: ユーモアで包んだ騒音の苦情

items.en: Just to play devil's advocate, are we sure customers actually want this, or do we just want to build it?
items.ja: あえて反対の立場で言うけど、お客さんは本当にこれを求めてる？それとも僕らが作りたいだけ？ → つまり、計画に疑問がある。
items.speaker: bob
choices: He doubts customers really need it.
He knows customers asked for it.
items.note: devil's advocate＝あえて反対意見を言う役

items.en: I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure the numbers back that up.
items.ja: おっしゃることはわかりますが、数字がそれを裏付けているかは疑問です。 →「確かに。データを出して一緒に見ましょう。」
items.speaker: tammy
choices: Fair. Let me pull the data and we can look at it together.
I'm coming from the Chicago office.
Yes, I backed it all up last night.
items.note: see where you’re coming from は反論の前置き

items.en: With all due respect, that's not what was agreed in the last meeting.
items.ja: お言葉ですが、それは前回の会議で合意した内容と違います。 → つまり、強く反対している。
items.speaker: fang
choices: He firmly disagrees with what's being said.
He respects the decision and agrees.
items.note: With all due respect の後は強い反論

items.en: Honestly, I couldn't agree more, but that's not the part I'm worried about.
items.ja: 正直、大賛成よ。でも私が心配しているのはそこじゃないの。
items.speaker: nana
items.note: couldn't agree more＝大賛成。could との差は n't

items.en: Can we park that for now and come back to it once we've seen the budget?
items.ja: それはいったん置いておいて、予算を見てから戻りませんか？ →「いいですね。来週の議題に入れましょう。」
items.speaker: reneigh
choices: Sure, let's put it on next week's agenda.
The parking lot's full, I'm afraid.
items.note: park＝いったん保留する。駐車の話ではない

items.en: Purple for a law firm's logo? Well, it'll certainly get noticed.
items.ja: 法律事務所のロゴに紫？ まあ、確かに目立つでしょうね。 → つまり、いいとは思っていない。
items.speaker: katt
choices: She thinks it's eye-catching and perfect.
She wants it to stand out even more.
items.note: certainly get noticed は婉曲な否定。褒めていない

items.en: I think we're going around in circles. Can we just agree to disagree and move on?
items.ja: 堂々巡りになってる気がする。意見の違いは違いとして、先に進めない？ →「いいよ。両方の意見を議事録に残そう。」
items.speaker: beau
choices: Fine by me. Let's note both views in the minutes.
Sure, I agree with you completely.
The circle chart is on slide three.
items.note: agree to disagree＝違いを認めて先へ。賛成ではない

items.en: As you know, we've been reviewing the team structure, and unfortunately, your role is one of the ones affected.
items.ja: ご存じのとおりチーム体制を見直してきたが、残念ながら君の職もその対象になった。 → つまり、ポジションがなくなる。
items.speaker: tom-nook
choices: You're being promoted to a new role.
The review will happen next year.
items.note: role is affected は「職がなくなる」の婉曲表現

items.en: Unfortunately, the board decided not to go ahead with the project, at least for this year.
items.ja: 残念ながら、役員会は少なくとも今年はこのプロジェクトを進めないと決めました。 →「残念です。来年また動く可能性は？」
items.speaker: poppy
choices: That's disappointing. Any chance it comes back next year?
Great, so when do we start?
items.note: not go ahead＝中止。at least で来年に余地

items.en: The parts are on back order, so we're looking at six to eight weeks, not the two we said.
items.ja: 部品が入荷待ちなので、お伝えした2週間ではなく、6〜8週間かかりそうです。
items.speaker: lucky
items.note: not the two we said は前の約束。最長は8
items.tts: The parts are on back order, so we're lookin' at six to eight weeks, not the two we said.
items.ask: 新しい見込みは 最長 何週間？

items.en: Thanks so much for your time. The team really enjoyed meeting you, but we decided to go in a different direction.
items.ja: お時間をありがとうございました。チームもお会いできて喜んでいましたが、別の方向で進めることになりました。 → つまり、不採用。
items.speaker: audie
choices: The team is moving to a new office.
items.note: different direction＝不採用を伝える定型句
